# Your Daily Briefing — Tuesday 28 October

Yesterday was a genuine rest day — no training, 4,918 steps, and a solid 9.1 hours of sleep. Your body burned 2,394 kcal, essentially matching your 2,300 target, which is great balance. A quiet day done right.

Recovery is mixed. Your resting HR of 51 bpm and stress score of 30 are both excellent signals. However, your HRV at 87ms sits below your 98–120ms baseline, suggesting your nervous system is still catching up. Don't panic — one night of extra sleep often precedes a rebound. Stick to your planned session today, but keep intensity controlled. If something feels off within the first 10 minutes, pull back.

With HRV suppressed, prioritise protein today — hit that 175g target deliberately rather than hoping it happens. Front-load it at breakfast and lunch while your digestion is sharpest.
